## Environment
* OS Version: Ubuntu 24.04 <!-- e.g, Ubuntu 24.04 -->
* Source or binary build? Binary build, version 8.15.0
  <!-- If binary, which version? -->
  <!-- If source, which branch and what is the latest commit? -->

## Description
* Expected behavior: As per the documentation, calling Actor::WorldPose should return the combined actor and trajectory pose <!-- Tell us what you expected to happen -->
* Actual behavior: The function returns the actor's pose without taking into account the trajectory pose <!-- What happened instead -->

## Steps to reproduce
<!-- Provide steps so we can try to reproduce this issue -->

1. Create an actor with a scripted trajectory, I am using the example at https://gazebosim.org/docs/harmonic/actors/ 
2. Access the actor's world pose from a C++ system plugin using Actor::WorldPose
3. The method returns the actor's base pose without taking into account trajectory
new_candidates.title: Actor::WorldPose always returns the actor's base pose when using an SDF scripted trajectory
